title: rtsp: recover from truncated RTP before RTSP response
body:
Fixes #23473

When an interleaved RTP frame is truncated, the next RTSP response can be consumed as frame payload. Recognize the RTSP status line while parsing an incomplete RTP frame, discard the truncated frame, and resume RTSP header parsing.

Add a regression to test 571 that sends a truncated interleaved frame before the next RTSP response.

Tests:
- TFLAGS=571 -n cmake --build build --target tests -j2 (pass)
- ./scripts/checksrc.pl lib/rtsp.c (pass)
- git diff --check (pass)

files.patch:
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 # 1. giving an evil payload (with $)
 # 2. Giving evil content (SDP starting with $)
 # 3. packing rtp after headers, after content, and at the start
+# 4. an incomplete interleaved frame before the next RTSP response
 <info>
 <keywords>
 RTSP
@@ -56,6 +57,7 @@ rtp: part 2 channel 0 size 196
 rtp: part 2 channel 0 size 124
 rtp: part 2 channel 0 size 824
 rtp: part 2 channel 0 size 18 size_err -6
+rtp: part 2 channel 0 size 0 size_err 16
 rtp: part 3 channel 1 size 10
 rtp: part 3 channel 0 size 50
 rtp: part 4 channel 0 size 798
